Agent Dynamics

An offline, Python-rendered visual player. Observe both private belief states and the external events that change them.

The location shown inside the environment is viewer-only truth. Agents receive only explicit observations and messages. The reset and communication schedule are supplied, not learned. There are no network calls.
What changes at the turning point?

A report contradicts A's current model. A expands its candidate set, archives stale receipts, and explicitly informs B. The two agents eventually narrow the possibilities to two source/sensor pairs. Repetition leaves that ambiguity intact; a separately available calibration resolves it. This illustrates belief revision, not recursive improvement of the update algorithm.
